# Docs-Shared Preview Fixtures

This book exists for one reason: to render **every mdBook feature the Liara
templates are expected to support**, so a docs-shared pull request can be eyeballed
before it ships to every module.

If something here looks broken in a preview build, the template change in the PR
probably caused it. That's the whole point.

> This is a synthetic fixture. None of the APIs or guides below describe real
> engine behavior.

Start with the [Feature gallery](./features.md), then check the
[Code & callouts](./code-and-callouts.md) page for syntax highlighting and
admonitions.
